features: ENHANCED PLA PRO+ STRENGTH: WOL3D Blue PLA PRO+ 1.75mm filament delivers superior strength, impact resistance and toughness over standard PLA, ideal for functional parts, prototypes, tools, engineering models and daily 3D printing

PRECISION 1.75MM FILAMENT: Manufactured with accurate 1.75mm diameter and tight dimensional tolerance for smooth extrusion, reduced clogging, consistent filament feeding, excellent layer bonding and high quality FDM 3D printer results

UNIVERSAL FDM PRINTER COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with Bambu Lab, Creality Ender, Prusa, Anycubic, FlashForge, QIDI, Sovol, Elegoo and most FDM 3D printers using 1.75mm PLA filament for reliable printing performance

ECO-FRIENDLY & EASY TO PRINT: Biodegradable PLA PRO+ filament made from renewable materials offers low odor, minimal warping, smooth printing, excellent bed adhesion and reliable performance for home, school and professional use
VIBRANT BLUE FINISH: Premium filament produces glossy, smooth and detailed prints, perfect for miniatures, cosplay, architectural models, mechanical parts, DIY projects and creative 3D printing
